comment: What the party says when a hero dies, after the fight is over (src/farewell.cpp). {dead} = the fallen hero's first name, {town} = the nearest town. 'say' = what each hero says over anyone; 'pair' = 'Speaker>Dead' lines used first when they apply (Caramon and Raistlin are twins, Riverwind and Goldmoon are wed ...); 'Nomad' covers every recruit and refugee. Goldmoon is the party's only cleric: 'goldmoon' has her words for a good, a neutral or an evil (Raistlin) fallen hero. Raistlin is the one dark soul in the party. Edit freely.

Sturm: {dead} fell with honour. I will see it is remembered.
A Knight's duty is to guard the living, and I failed {dead}. Never again.
Est Sularus oth Mithas. My honour is my life, {dead}. Yours was both.
Gone with courage. There is no better end, but I grieve it.
Caramon: Ah, no. Not {dead}. Not after everything.
I should've been standing closer. Forgive me, {dead}.
I'm no good with words, {dead}. I'm just sorry.
Somebody tell me this isn't true. {dead}...
Raistlin: How tiresome. {dead} was a fool to stand there.
Death is no tragedy, only the price of carelessness. {dead} was careless.
So {dead} is dead. One learns to be unmoved, or one learns nothing.
Do not look at me. I warned them all that weakness kills.
Tanis: I'm sorry, {dead}. I should have led us better.
Another friend lost. I don't know how many more I can bear.
{dead} was one of the best of us. It's a bitter day.
Gods... {dead}. We'll carry this with us.
Goldmoon: Oh, {dead}. So much light, and gone so soon.
I'm so sorry, {dead}. I could not reach you in time.
Riverwind: {dead} walked a good path. I will not forget it.
A warrior's spirit does not die. Go well, {dead}.
The Plainsmen say the dead run free upon the grass. Run, {dead}.
I grieve. {dead} deserved a longer road.
Flint: Bah. Why does it always have to be someone good?
I'm too old for burying friends. Blast it, {dead}...
Don't you dare get sentimental on me. ...Rest well, {dead}.
Hrmph. {dead} wasn't supposed to go before me.
Tasslehoff: Oh, {dead}... that isn't funny at all. Get up? Please?
I never thought I'd run out of stories, but I can't think of one.
I'm sorry, {dead}. I'll tell everyone how brave you were.
It's very quiet without {dead}. I don't like it at all.
Gilthanas: {dead} fought well. The elves will sing of this.
I am sorry, {dead}. May the stars keep you.
Another life taken by the Queen's dragons. I'll not forget {dead}.
We have lost a friend. I'll mourn the longer for it.
Laurana: I'm so sorry, {dead}. I wasn't brave enough to stop it.
I never wanted this war. Not for {dead}. Not for anyone.
We'll remember you, {dead}. We'll remember you always.
Nomad: I did not know {dead} long, but I grieve all the same.
{dead} fought bravely. It's a hard loss.
I'm sorry. We lost a good one in {dead}.
By the gods, {dead}... I am sorry.

Caramon>Raistlin: Raist... Raistlin. My brother. I promised to watch over you.
Oh, Raistlin. I never could keep you safe. I'm so sorry.
Don't you leave me, Raist. Not now. Not like this.
Raistlin>Caramon: My brother... fool. Great, loyal fool.
Caramon. You never did know when to stop protecting me.
...Caramon. The one who always carried me. Now who will?
Riverwind>Goldmoon: Goldmoon... my heart. My wife. No.
Goldmoon! Not you. Gods above, not you.
I'd give every breath I have to hear you speak again, Goldmoon.
Goldmoon>Riverwind: Riverwind... my husband. Wait for me.
Riverwind. You said you would never leave me.
Tanis>Laurana: Laurana! I should have stayed beside you.
Laurana... I never told you enough. I never told you enough.
Laurana>Tanis: Tanis... please. Tanis, I need you.
Without Tanis, who's left to hold us together?
Flint>Tasslehoff: Blasted kender... I told you not to touch anything. Why did it have to be this?
Tas! Tas, you little pest... ah, hang it all.
I never once said I liked you, you scamp. I did.
Tasslehoff>Flint: Flint! Flint, I never got to give you back your pouch...
You can't be dead, Flint. Who'll scold me now?
Oh, Flint. You old grump. I'll miss you more than anything.
Sturm>Raistlin: A dark soul, but a comrade. I'll not rejoice.
Tanis>Raistlin: Even Raistlin. Even after everything. Poor Caramon...
Gilthanas>Laurana: My sister... Laurana. No. No, no.
Laurana! I should never have let you walk into this.
Laurana>Gilthanas: Gilthanas... my brother. Oh, please no.
Sturm>Tanis: Tanis, you were my friend and my captain. I'll miss you.
Tanis>Sturm: Sturm. Brave, stubborn Sturm. I'll miss you.
Caramon>Sturm: Sturm... the best man I knew. I can't believe it.
Flint>Sturm: He died like he lived: stubborn as a rock. Ah, Sturm.

good: May Paladine and Mishakal welcome you, {dead}. Rest in peace.
Rest in peace, my friend. The gods are waiting.
Go in peace, {dead}. May the angels carry you home.
Fly free, {dead}. Be at peace beyond the reach of any dragon.
neutral: I mourn you, {dead}. I hope you find your way.
Be at peace, {dead}. I hope you find your rest.
I'm so sorry, {dead}. May the gods be gentle with you.
evil: Raistlin... I pray the gods are kinder to you than the world was.
Whatever darkness you chose, may the light find you now, Raistlin.
Rest, Raistlin. Perhaps now you may be at peace.

prayer: [Goldmoon lays a hand on {dead} and whispers a blessing]
pray_long: [Goldmoon kneels and prays for a few moments]
carry: We'll take {dead} home to {town} when this is over.
{dead} should rest in {town}. We'll bring them there.
return: We'll come back for {dead}'s body when we're done here.
We cannot carry {dead} now. We'll return when it's over.
We'll bury {dead} properly once this is finished.
